Dossier.description: Verification sheet for one zone: what was observed, what supports it, what else could explain it.
Dossier.title: Dossier

EvidenceSummary.description: Counts of independent supports, derived from the recorded comparisons (never typed by hand).
EvidenceSummary.title: EvidenceSummary

OpticalGroup.description: Radar comparisons that rely on the same pair of optical scenes: one temporal reference, not several.
OpticalGroup.title: OpticalGroup

Profile.description: Result of one (control, quantile) profile for one pair.
Profile.title: Profile

ReferenceEvidence.description:
A structured independent reference (field observation or dated, geolocated annotation).

A text marker is not a reference: `effective()` states what a reference must carry before it can support the
level `independently_validated`. Every field is recorded; none is inferred.
ReferenceEvidence.title: ReferenceEvidence

Uncertainty.description: Statistical uncertainty of one measured value.
Uncertainty.title: Uncertainty
